SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y') as date, COUNT(*) as count
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as date, COUNT(*) as count
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, COUNT(*) as count

AND create_time <= #{end}
